_comment: STATIC SCHEMA/EXAMPLE TEMPLATE ONLY -- not a real, executable manifest. Real per-run manifests are always written by `raging_bolt_eval.py manifest --out PATH` to a caller-specified path outside this tracked allowlist; this file is never overwritten by that command and is never read as a real manifest by run/summarize. Same convention as profiles/outcome/pokemon-ai.example.json's status:example_only.

protocol_identity.seat_alternation_rule: head_to_head.py --first-player, alternated by the run subcommand across scheduled attempts for the same opponent/segment
protocol_identity.decision_time_measurement: wall-clock time.perf_counter() around each agent's own decision call, tagged actor=a|b per decision; summarize filters to actor=a (the arm under measurement, since run always invokes head_to_head.py with the arm as --agent-a) before computing decision-time/observation-count cells; import/clone/engine-step/output-write time excluded

game_rng_control.reason: No seed/RNG-control parameter exists anywhere in cg.api/cg.game's Python surface (confirmed absence); whether the compiled libcg.so has internal RNG state beyond that surface is Unknown. This harness never claims seed control.

protocol_identity.illegal_action_rate_representation: Wilson score interval (same method as win/error/timeout rates); for any exact-zero or exact-n/n count the interval's bound on that side is never exactly 0 or 1 for finite n -- this holds under Wilson, Newcombe, or Clopper-Pearson alike and is a property of interval estimation, not a bug. Raw counts additionally reported as a non-normative diagnostic outside the Gatekeeper-shaped cell.
